title: Postcard: Rink Lines
tagline: No full build today, so here is a postcard: the ice, drawn as neon, with a few restless pucks.
description: Today's full build did not finish, so this page is a generative postcard instead: rink lines, drawn from the date alone, animated, with a still SVG for reduced-motion and no-script visitors. Full builds resume tomorrow.
makingOf: A safety-net page. The composition (Rink Lines) and its palette (split, hue 23) are chosen from the date 2026-10-15 alone (seed a2e72708), so the same day always draws the same picture. One scene description feeds the animated canvas, the static SVG and the thumbnail. No research and no network.
